name: Afghanistan

chips.label: Earned prosperity
chips.why: Institutions roughly match or exceed what income predicts - durable.
chips.rule: MI residual vs. the log-GDP regression (the durability gap): below -0.03 → granted, otherwise earned (a ±0.03 tolerance treats near-zero gaps as in-line).

chips.label: Lopsided · weakest: Institutions
chips.why: Spread between the strongest and weakest pillar - the country's structural shape.

verdict: Mixed structural profile - prosperity roughly in line with institutions - lopsided (institutions the weak point).

relational.label: Afghanistan (Islamic Republic) 2019 (FRAGILE + SHIELD WITHDRAWN) -> COLLAPSED 2021
relational.joint_reading: MODERATE structural exposure + weak response: not relationally over-determined, but with little to absorb a shock - fragile if one lands, and fatal if an external prop is removed (e.g. Afghanistan 2021, which fell within weeks of the withdrawal).
relational.outcome_factual: Survived 2001-2021 on external backing; collapsed within weeks of the US withdrawal (Kabul fell 15 Aug 2021). Shield removed -> fell.
